facts.fact: PRNigeria reports that the Head of the Civil Service of the Federation announced the deployment of a Service-Wide GPT trained on the Constitution, Public Service Rules and circulars, which has recorded over 25,000 chats.
PRNigeria reports the Head of the Civil Service of the Federation saying the Service-Wide GPT, with over 25,000 chats, shows growing adoption across Ministries, Departments and Agencies.

systems.owner: Office of the Head of the Civil Service of the Federation
